description: The chart, labeled Figure 8, represents the problem distribution based on correctness under two settings: with knowledge (w/ KNOWLEDGE) and without knowledge (w/o KNOWLEDGE) using Zero-Shot. The second slice, representing "medium" problems, is roughly 45% and is also linked to the w/ KNOWLEDGE setting. The third slice, representing "hard" problems, is about 15% and corresponds to the w/o KNOWLEDGE setting, although the exact color coding for the settings is not specified. The chart includes a legend, but its details are not visible in the provided information. The slices are not visually emphasized or exploded. The chart appears to compare the distribution of problems by difficulty under the two knowledge settings.
